samir: opened PR 824 to migrate the observability quickstart to Console v2. Main asks: add Kotlin SDK snippet, update dashboard YAML to new metric keys, and fix a couple of broken tracehook links.

ivy: I can author the Kotlin snippet. keep it compact and show trace attach + a cost tag. will mirror the existing Java sample but much shorter.

docs-bot: lint: docs/observability/quickstart.md -> broken link https://old.docs/tracehook (404); image docs/img/heatmap-old.png -> 404

samir: thanks. also note: dashboard metric rename -> use `redwood.request.latency.p95` and `redwood.request.cost.usd_per_1k`. update examples so dashboards don't break.

ivy: draft Kotlin snippet pushed:
```kotlin
val client = RedwoodClient(System.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
val ctx = client.newTraceContext("obs-quickstart")
ctx.setTag("cost_center","kotlin-play") // used by dashboards to attribute cost
// tip: tune client.config.maxBatchTokens to balance latency vs cost
val res = client.dashboards().render(ctx, "compact")
println(res.shareUrl)
```

nora: I'll replace the missing image with a responsive PNG and add redirects for the old tracehook URL.

ci-bot: queued: frontmatter linkcheck + image existence smoke test.

samir: plan is to merge after CI green and one docs review. tagging @nora for the redirects and @ivy for the final snippet tweak (add inline comment about MaxBatchTokens).
